entries.357bae4e90541a44: The business strategy set in May 2016 sets out expanding sales in Latin America and Southeast Asia centered on local subsidiaries in Chile and Thailand, developing and selling high value-added products and services, strengthening sales of raw netting materials and consumables, promoting a centralized management system for consolidated group companies, and making proposals as an industry leader. Challenges to address include developing and differentiating original products, expanding sales of fishing nets and strengthening the tailoring division, securing and developing human resources, optimizing sales prices, and recycling discarded fishing nets.
